survey: An arched blue wooden door seen straight on, at roughly eye level. The orange wooden frame wraps the arch and both sides, and ends in two plinth blocks that stand on a strip of paving stones. The door's vertical planks and its upper and lower panels are drawn flat to the camera, with straight verticals and level horizontal rails. A flower wreath with an orange bow hangs flat against the upper panel. A round brass knob on an oval backplate sits on the right stile and is seen face-on, with only a slight side bulge. Two hinges sit on the left edge. Ivy climbs the wall around the frame. The paving is seen slightly from above, which fits a camera just above the door's middle. The plinths and the frame's slight inner depth agree with that same frontal view. All repeated elements (planks, panel rails, stones) keep equal spacing as they should on a face-on surface, and the door meets the ground level and square.
